notes.title: Patch 1.0.9 is live
notes.content: A small patch to improve support of older systems. Windows 7 should be properly supported now.

notes.title: Pupupu is now released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45554501/424032c91cca7e99729592982ead8fb29ec54ab5.png[/img]
I hope you like it, and have as much fun as I had while developing it! 
To all of my friends and beloved ones, thank you for your help and ongoing support.

Support and bug fixing for the game will continue, so if you find any problems or have any questions - feel free to post here on Steam forums, or hop onto Volcanic Giraffe Discord chat:
https://discordapp.com/channels/579390425253543977/1360387780060119162
